atoms.text: A piece of music consists of many bars. A bar is a short section of a particular duration. The length of a bar is given by the time signature.
The vertical lines that divide the bars are called bar lines.

example.a: This melody is divided into two bars.
example.sound: This melody is divided into two bars.

example.a: The bar lines separate the bars in a piece of music.
example.sound: The bar lines separate the bars in a piece of music.

atoms.a: How many bars do you see here?

instruction.text: Select each of the four measures one after another.

atoms.text: At the beginning of a piece of music, you will find the time signature.
atoms.sound: At the beginning of a piece of music, you will find the time signature.

hint.text: The four-four time, also known as common time, is one of the many time signatures. Other examples are the three-four time or the six-eight time.

atoms.text: The number on top shows how many units of time there are in a measure. The lower number shows how long these units of time are.
